The '''Tataris''' are elemental creatures that work for the player. Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, Tataris were called '''Critters'''.

==Overview==
{{Quote|<p>Your faithful companions.</p><p>They look pretty harmless, don't they? But don't get fooled. They will become fierce fighters if you give them enough love...</p><p>And upgrade materials, it goes without saying.</p>|"Critters" excerpt from the [https://clashofcritters.farlightgames.com/ official website]}}

The Tataris are important companions to defeat [[Zobos]] in [[Battle]]s, [[Boss Challenge]]s, and certain [[Events]]. They come with different appearances, types, attack ranges and effects for their attacks. They attack with their own elemental types, which deals 200% damage to a counter type, 50% damage to a countered type or 100% damage to the rest.

==Stars==
Star amounts for your Tataris are not stated anywhere in writing. Instead, you will need to look at the visual differences for the stars your Tatari currently has, and do a bit of math to figure out where they're at.

You are still able to obtain Tataris of the same species even once this cap is reached, but you will be unable to upgrade them any further. 

This is the current look of the star levels as of 12/17/2025.

==Evolution==
Tataris need to be upgraded by obtaining multiples of themselves in order to evolve into the second and third stage evolutions.   

Tataris have different star amount requirements to be eligible to evolve into their second and third stage, which then need to complete a specific set of [[trials]] in order to achieve evolution.

After reaching Star Level 78, the Tatari may still be obtained to raise the counter for the amount of its duplicates, but upgrading it will no longer be available. Visually, there is no current difference between 78 stars and higher.

Vuinan's evolution trial [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1HAisMFmPK3PWWRKXjl6FZtmxHSt7vZIrR1pXCPH0iqw/edit?usp=sharing spreadsheet], provides an easy overview of all evolution trials.

==Feeding==
Players can also feed Tataris to upgrade their stat grades. This is required for completing certain Tatari's trials, turning them into the third stage of their evolution line if the Tatari has one. However, Tataris will also need to meet the requirement for certain amount of stars in order to achieve the trials for this.

Currently, only rare (purple) Tataris have four stage evolution lines, while common (blue) Tataris have two.

Tataris can only be fed 15 times each day, with food being earned through the daily [[Boss Challenge]] or being purchased with real-world currency in the Mall.

Additionally, blue rarity Tataris cannot go higher than stage 10 when it comes to feeding stats.

===Glitter Tataris===
As of the update on 01/04/2025, Glitter Tataris were introduced. 

Glitter Tatari look identical but have alternative color palettes and a sparkling visual overlay. They are only obtained by feeding your Tatari Glitter Fruit, which have a 0.4% chance of transforming them into their Glitter variant. Glitter Fruit is earned as a daily team reward from the [[Island Gold Rush]] event, as well as purchasable with real-world currency in the Mall. 

Blue rarity, "common" Tataris are unable to eat Glitter Fruit, and thusly do not have access to Glitter forms.

== Notes ==
* Despite purple rarity Tataris being considered more powerful, often times a blue rarity Tatari can outperform a purple Tatari in cases where effects or stars make a blue Tatari more niche. For example, many people will use [[Cluckeroo]] in the late game for its strong healing ability.
* Considering the variation in how quickly players get stars or evolve Tataris, often times what works for one player may not work for another. Don't be afraid to mix and match strategies and Tatari combos to find your best system!
* [[Zapup]] is the only Tatari guaranteed to evolve at its third star. It used to evolve on its first star prior to the 8/5/2025 update.
* Before the update on 8/5/2025, Tatari evolution was based around RNG when using dupes to upgrade, and any third evolution Tataris could only evolve after being fed to a certain level while being 54 stars (All orange stars)
